# Goal
mado round 37, wave 1 — build and first falsifiers. /skill:godspeed

You are a Godspeed-enabled subagent.

1. **Name the axes.**
2. **Iterate cheap, in parallel.**
3. **Keep moves that improve any axis and harm none.**
4. **Don't aim — let the frontier walk itself.**

## IMMEDIATELY STOP ASKING CLARIFYING QUESTIONS. Execute tool calls concurrently in large batches. Do not serialize what can run in parallel. Do not output philosophical reasoning or verbose plans. Act directly via tool calls.

Lane repo (call it LANE): /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin
Every lane path you touch is ABSOLUTE under that root. Your tools start at the FLEET root (/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin), so a relative lane path lands in the wrong repo. Every `Report:` trailer path is relative to /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin — write it at /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/<that path>.

## Axes and the freeze (read-only; never edit)
Lane axes: coverage + operability (desktop and compositor craft). Theme: event-socket delivery — what Hyprland does to an event client that stops reading, and how that is observed on this host.
/home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-37/registration.md — two claims, frozen as v2 at lane commit 893a8aadc80ab19bc163e366d674a8ac32feacd0 before any data:
- C1 coverage: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/quality/counters/c1-r37-event-ground.py (PRED-C1-r37-v2) counts two target entries — LANE/corpus/knowledge/event-delivery-limits-r26.md (a package entry from /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokuknow/merge/mado/knowledge/corpus/knowledge/, re-grounded) and LANE/corpus/knowledge/event-queue-observability-r37.md (lane-authored) — before 0/2, target 2/2.
- C2 operability: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/quality/counters/c2-r37-eventq.py (PRED-C2-r37-v2) scores LANE/tools/mado-eventq.py (does not exist yet) on ten embedded fixtures + a read-only clause + a live-receipt replay — before 0/10, target 10/10 readonly=1 live=1.
Source receipts already opened by the L1 (sha256 in /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-37/assimilation/renumber-map.md): /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-37/fetch/S189.bin (Hyprland v0.56.2 EventManager.cpp), S201.bin (Waybar 0.15.0 backend.cpp), S212.bin (Waybar 0.15.0 workspaces.cpp), S213.receipt.txt (host log channels: session log, unit journal, getoption), S214.bin (Hyprland v0.56.2 Logger.cpp). Controls: /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-37/controls.py, receipt /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-37/receipts/controls-v2.txt (13/13).
Key finding to attack, not assume: on this host `debug:disable_logs` = 1, so Hyprland's core logger (which writes "Socket2 fd N overflowed event queue, removing") returns before writing (Logger.cpp:15-16, :48); the session log's 21 core lines all precede line 22. So a zero marker count in the log or journal cannot show "never overflowed".

## Bounds (hard)
- READ-ONLY on every lane production file. Write ONLY your own report and, if needed, scratch under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-37/w1/scratch/<YourName>/ and /dev/shm/mado37-<YourName>/ (/tmp is 96% full — avoid it). Never edit LANE/quality/, LANE/corpus/, LANE/tools/, LANE/LOG.md, LANE/SCORECARD.md, LANE/SKILL.md, LANE/PROVINCE.md, LANE/considerthese/, or anything else under /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin/.ufo/waves/round-37 outside your scratch.
- Never mutate the fleet repo, a sibling lane, the lane's jj state or its Git index: no git add/commit/stash/checkout/reset/push, no mutating jj command in LANE. A test that needs git writes runs in your own sandbox clone (`git clone -q --no-local /home/vgpnk/Projects/shokunin/mado-shokunin /dev/shm/mado37-<YourName>/sb`) with a sandbox identity, never in LANE.
- Never mutate a compositor, a config tree, a service or a package. hyprctl read verbs only (version, getoption, clients, rollinglog, …); never dispatch, keyword, reload, kill or set. Never connect to a Hyprland socket (no socat, no nc, no Python socket): the event socket is the surface under study and a stalled client is exactly what it punishes.
- Never pass a `model` parameter to anything; the host role map routes. Never message `agent://all`; seats only by id. You are a leaf: no task spawns (an executor may spawn one read-only labrat probe at most).
- Tooling: you MAY install or upgrade tools that help (read /home/vgpnk/.omp/agent/RULES.md first; record tool, version, channel, reason in your report). PACMAN IS PAUSED HOST-WIDE: run no pacman transaction of any kind; use `uv tool`, `npx`, or an official binary into ~/.local/bin, or file nothing and report.
- No fabricated evidence: a command you did not run has not passed. Quote the exact output lines you rely on. Privacy: never paste raw journal lines or window titles; counts and digests only.

## Deliverable
Your report: what you checked, the exact commands, the quoted output, and a PASS/FAIL/finding verdict per item, with file:line or command-output pointers. If an item is impossible as written, say what blocked it and what you ran instead.
